<subject>Interconnection Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the IA has to address ConnectNet one-to-many with Maple & Crown and DataFlow one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a separate ConnectNet MSA one-to-many with Maple & Crown and separate DataFlow MSA one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a single NetworkLink application that addresses TelcoConnect, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Travis McCullough <Travis.McCullough@maplecrown.ca>
Sent: Tuesday, July 9, 2024 8:33 PM
To: Lee Mills; Nicholas Porter; John Cummings; Bradley Miller; Douglas Dixon; Harry M Collins; Sandra Wood
Subject: Interconnection Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the IA omitting the distinction between transactions on DataFlow and transactions on ConnectNet. If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post services on DataFlow, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" switching hub. However, we will need to develop a different set of MSAs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on DataFlow, since the services transacted on DataFlow are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard MSAs.
